The background foliage shows signs of algorithmic smoothing/waxiness rather than optical bokeh (severity ~1.5). No catastrophic structural failures (extra limbs, impossible geometry) were detected. The high mask confidence supports overall structural coherence. The artifact score is penalized from a perfect 5.0 due to these grounding and texture fidelity issues.
